description: (tikajs-u03v, Fixer D) Adapted from xberg (MIT) crates/xberg/tests/html_declared_charset.rs: a legacy-encoded page is read in the charset its meta declares (comment-before-declaration); no U+FFFD. Tika 4.2.0 (oracle) reads this as windows-1252: its HtmlEncodingDetector does not take a meta that sits in a comment while another declares anything (measured with /rmeta: HtmlEncodingDetector->windows-1252[DECLARATIVE]).
